products.name: AHRF county health workforce and resources
CMS Original Medicare GV
products.publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Office of Enterprise Data and Analytics (OEDA)

release.source_release_id: OM GV PUF May 2026 update (2014-2024 CSV)

limitations: Original Medicare (fee-for-service) beneficiaries with Part A and Part B only. Medicare Advantage enrollees, people with only Part A or only Part B, and people not on Medicare are excluded.
All ages: people under 65 who qualify through disability or ESRD and people 65 and older. Not an age 65+ measure.
Utilization and spending describe this beneficiary population, not all residents of the area.
Standardized payments remove geographic payment-rate differences. They are not adjusted for inflation, and CMS states they are not adjusted for health status.
CMS suppresses values when fewer than 11 beneficiaries or users are counted. Suppressed values are not estimated.
State and county values are published separately by CMS. CHIP does not add counties into states.
No tract, ZIP, or sub-county values are published.
No confidence interval or margin of error is published.

products.name: EPA AirData annual AQI by county
products.publisher: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, AirData (Air Quality System)
limitations: Annual historical AQI summary for one calendar year; not current or forecast conditions.
Coverage reflects where monitors reported to EPA AQS; most counties have no monitor.
No reported value means no county summary was published, not that the air was clean.
Days with AQI varies by county; counts of Good days should be read against it.
Values reflect the pollutants each county measures; many counties measure only some pollutants.

products.name: USDA Food Environment Atlas
products.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Economic Research Service (ERS)

release.source_release_id: Food Environment Atlas July 2025 release (CSV files, last updated 7/30/2025)

limitations: Each measure has its own observation year (2018–2023); they are not one snapshot and not current conditions.
County values only. USDA publishes no state value for these measures, and CHIP does not add or average counties.
Low access is distance to a supermarket or large grocery store. It is not a food-desert designation and does not measure diet quality.
Authorized SNAP or WIC retailers and listed farmers’ markets show program participation and directory listings, not the foods sold, and are not a current store directory.
Connecticut values exist only for its eight former counties and cannot be shown on the 2024 planning-region boundaries. Puerto Rico is outside the Atlas.
-9999 or N/A (not available) and -8888 (county did not exist in that year) are shown separately from zero.

measures.publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Office of Enterprise Data and Analytics (OEDA)
measures.label: Original Medicare beneficiaries
measures.definition: Count of Medicare beneficiaries who were enrolled in Part A and Part B, as well as Original Medicare coverage for all Medicare entitled months. New enrollees and beneficiaries that died during the year are included as long as they met the above criteria.
measures.interpretation: Counts people in the Original Medicare study population only. Excludes Medicare Advantage enrollees and people with only Part A or only Part B. It is not a resident population or an age 65+ count.

measures.publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Office of Enterprise Data and Analytics (OEDA)
measures.label: Standardized Medicare payment per beneficiary
measures.unit: US dollars per Original Medicare beneficiary (2024, nominal)
measures.definition: Actual per capita Original Medicare payment for beneficiaries, adjusted for geographic differences in payment rates.
measures.denominator: Original Medicare beneficiaries in the area (per capita).
measures.interpretation: Standardization removes geographic differences in Medicare payment rates for the same service, such as local wage and input-cost adjustments. CMS's catalog description says it also removes extra payments such as medical education and disproportionate-share hospital payments. It is not adjusted for inflation. CMS's catalog states it does not adjust for beneficiaries' health status, so CHIP does not present it as risk-adjusted.

measures.publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Office of Enterprise Data and Analytics (OEDA)
measures.label: Inpatient covered stays per 1,000 beneficiaries
measures.unit: covered stays per 1,000 Original Medicare beneficiaries
measures.definition: Number of Hospital Inpatient covered stays per 1,000 OM beneficiaries.
measures.denominator: All Original Medicare beneficiaries in the area, not only inpatient users.
measures.interpretation: Hospital inpatient includes IPPS acute hospitals, critical access hospitals, inpatient psychiatric facilities, and other inpatient Part A services. Only Medicare-covered stays are counted.

measures.publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Office of Enterprise Data and Analytics (OEDA)
measures.label: Emergency room (ER) visits per 1,000 beneficiaries
measures.unit: ER visits per 1,000 Original Medicare beneficiaries
measures.definition: Number of inpatient or hospital outpatient Emergency Room (ER) visits per 1,000 OM beneficiaries.
measures.denominator: All Original Medicare beneficiaries in the area.
measures.interpretation: CMS labels these Emergency Room (ER) visits; visits that led to an inpatient admission and hospital outpatient visits are both counted.

measures.publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Office of Enterprise Data and Analytics (OEDA)
measures.label: All-cause 30-day hospital readmission rate
measures.unit: percent of acute hospital stays (CMS stores 0-1)
measures.definition: Percentage of inpatient readmissions within 30 days of an acute hospital stay during the reference period, regardless of whether the readmission was planned or unplanned.
measures.denominator: Acute hospital admissions where the beneficiary was discharged alive (not beneficiaries).
measures.interpretation: Counts all-cause readmissions, planned or unplanned. It is not risk-adjusted and is not the Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program measure. CHIP stores the CMS proportion unchanged and multiplies by 100 only for display.

measures.definition: Number of days in the year having an AQI value 0 through 50.

measures.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Economic Research Service (ERS)
measures.label: Low-income residents with low supermarket access (share of all residents)
measures.definition: Percentage of people in a county with low income and living more than 1 mile from a foodstore if in an urban area, or more than 10 miles from a foodstore if in a rural area.
measures.denominator: Total county population (2010 Census block population). The numerator is low-income residents only.
measures.interpretation: Share of all county residents who are low income and live beyond 1 mile (urban) or 10 miles (rural) from a supermarket or large grocery store. Not a food-desert designation, not a measure of diet quality, and based on 2019 store locations.

measures.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Economic Research Service (ERS)
measures.label: SNAP-authorized stores per 1,000 residents
measures.definition: The average monthly number of stores in the county authorized to accept SNAP per 1,000 county residents.
measures.interpretation: Authorized retailers of all types: supermarkets, grocery and convenience stores, supercenters, warehouse clubs, and specialty food stores. Retailer authorization does not indicate the healthfulness of foods sold. A 2023 average, not a current store directory.

measures.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Economic Research Service (ERS)
measures.label: WIC-authorized stores per 1,000 residents
measures.definition: The number of stores in a county that are authorized to accept WIC benefits per 1,000 population.
measures.interpretation: Stores authorized to accept WIC benefits. Authorization does not indicate the foods stocked or diet quality. A 2022 count, not a current store directory.

measures.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Economic Research Service (ERS)
measures.label: Farmers' markets per 1,000 residents
measures.definition: The number of farmers' markets in the county per 1,000 county residents.
measures.interpretation: Markets listed in a voluntary, self-reported directory in 2018. Zero means no market was listed, not that none operated. Not a current market directory.

measures.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Economic Research Service (ERS)
measures.label: Housing units with no car and low supermarket access
measures.definition: Percentage of housing units in a county that are without a car and more than 1 mile from a foodstore.
measures.denominator: Total county housing units. USDA's variable label says households; its definition uses housing units.
measures.interpretation: Substitute for grocery-store density. Uses a single 1-mile distance for every county, urban or rural. Not a food-desert designation and based on 2019 store locations.
